title: Decentralized cohort orchestrator with canary rehearsal warmup and snapshot replay
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Large customers increasingly request deterministic pre-deployment validation for canaries across heterogeneous regions. The existing centralized orchestrator performs live shadowing and slow canaries but is brittle when regional control planes lag. This change introduces a decentralized cohort orchestrator that performs an in-cluster canary rehearsal (warmup) using snapshot replay and token-based traffic fencing before promoting model variants. Motivation: reduce blast radius of bad model variants, allow rehearsals to run without affecting global traffic, and provide deterministic rollback candidates based on rehearsed telemetry. High level: - Introduces a lightweight cohort controller that elects a local steward per region/zone and coordinates rehearsal windows among stewards. - Rehearsal warmup: before any percentage promotion, the steward runs a replay of live traffic snapshots against the candidate model in a sidecar sandbox and collects the rehearsal metrics (latency, token-regression, top-k output drift). - Deferred commit with snapshot replay: commit decisions are gated on rehearsal anchors; if rehearsals diverge beyond thresholds, the orchestrator halts promotion and selects the highest-quality prior candidate for rollback. - Traffic fencing: uses short-lived token leases so rehearsals and early canaries can be isolated to cohort-bound traffic even if global routing lags. - Safety: introduces a replay simulator and an overlap checker that ensures rehearsal data does not leak PII; rehearsal runs use scrubbed snapshots by default. Checklist: [ ] design doc approved (docs/design/decentralized_cohort_orchestrator.md) [x] unit and integration tests for steward election and fencing [x] rehearsal simulator added and wired into CI as optional job [x] telemetry for per-cohort warmup metrics (histograms + event traces) [x] e2e rehearsal smoke test validated on staging Related work: ENG-4082 (decentralized rollouts), ENG-4127 (rehearsal simulator). Impact: reduces median time-to-detect regressions during staged promotions from ~18m to ~4m in our staging benchmarks and reduces rollback false positives by ensuring replay determinism. Rollout plan: - Canary merge to main as feature-flagged and disabled by default - Enable rehearsals for 5 pilot customers in us-west/eur region for 2 weeks - Monitor rehearsal divergence and rollout_rehearsal_failure_rate alarms - Gradually enable across regions if stable
commits_summary: 12 commits: initial steward election prototype; add snapshot replayer and scrubber; traffic-fencing token lease implementation; rehearsal simulator harness and k8s job; telemetry proto updates; e2e smoke tests and CI pipeline update; docs and design writeup; multiple fixes for race conditions under high concurrency.
review_threads: Diego Ramirez (reviewer): This is a big change to orchestration boundaries. Please add details on how steward election behaves under network partition. Author (Maya): Added leader-election fallback section in docs and a test that simulates partitioning (see commit 7f3c9ab).

Eve Chen (reviewer): Observability looks good; can we add per-cohort warmup histograms with percentile buckets? Author: Added histogram buckets to pkg/telemetry and updated rollout_events.proto, validated with local telemetry ingestion.
Liam O'Connor (approver): Ran rehearsal simulator on my laptop against a 3-node staging cluster and validated warmup metrics and fencing behavior. Approving once CI passes.
SRE (automated): ci/rollout_integration.yml: rehearsals job flaked once due to timeout; reran and green. Quarantined flaky test 'rehearsal_simulator::timeout' for follow-up.
Security (comment): Scrubber approach looks acceptable for PII but please file a data-protection review ticket before enabling for customers. Author: Created SUP-2198 and added note to docs.
merge_commit_message: squash: decentralized cohort orchestrator: add steward election, rehearsal warmup, snapshot replay, token-based fencing, and rehearsal simulator
release_notes: Feature: Decentralized cohort orchestrator with canary rehearsal warmup, deterministic snapshot replay for gated promotions, and traffic fencing via token leases. Adds rehearsal simulator and new telemetry for per-cohort warmup metrics. Opt-in via feature flag.
notes_on_testing: Unit tests added for steward election, token lease expiry, and snapshot scrubber. Integration tests run with rehearsal_simulator at low parallelism in CI. End-to-end rehearsals validated on a staging k8s cluster with 1k req/s synthetic cohorts; one flaky timeout required two CI reruns and was quarantined for follow-up (see test label). Performance: rehearsal replay overhead avg 12% CPU and <5ms p99 added latency in sandbox; warmup completes within target windows in our staging runs.
post_merge_actions: Monitor rollout_rehearsal_failure_rate and rehearsal_divergence_ratio dashboards for 14 days; enable feature-flag for first 5 pilot customers; SRE to run a controlled regional roll after 72h of stable rehearsals; follow-up ticket ENG-4199 to harden timeout backoffs and reduce flaky test coverage.
